source: Hand-traced from hdb-3room.webp (Task 16b diagnostic truth, not the P2 fixture), corrected in Task 16c after the independent review (task-16-review.md): wall centre lines in source pixels read from gridded crops and perpendicular ink profiles. thickness: wall kind as in P2 (exterior 230, interior 115, half 115, black blocks and jog connectors 230); mm_per_unit = 11000 mm / 965 px and 7400 mm / 623 px averaged.

method.convention: Controller ruling, Task 16c. A truth wall is the centre line of the drawn wall: a double line takes the midpoint of the face pair; a bold or filled stroke its centre; a bold outer stroke with a thin inner face their midpoint. Walls drawn as solid black blocks follow the block centre. Where the drawing jogs, the truth jogs too: two pieces plus a short connector (kind 'jog'). Doors, windows and passages are spanned. Isolated columns and piers are not walls; wall stubs >= 0.03 L (L = the plan region's long side, ~1110 source px, so >= 33 px), measured from the centre line of the wall they leave like every truth wall, are walls.
method.profile_check: Every wall changed in Task 16c was checked with perpendicular profiles (median of five profiles 1 px apart, 0.5 px steps, gray < 200, < 235 for the faint toilet-3 faces) at 20/50/80 % of its length; the values are in task-16c-report.md.
